header: {"User-Agent":"Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36","Referer":"https://www.101minc.com/","Accept":"text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.8","Accept-Language":"zh-CN,zh;q=0.9"}
exploreUrl:
<js>
var result = [];

var rankMap = {
    "排行": "allvisit",
    "收藏": "goodnum",
    "字数": "size",
    "连载": "lastupdate",
    "人气": "monthvisit",
    "推荐": "monthvote",
    "新书": "postdate",
    "热门": "allvote"
};

var rankType = infoMap["榜单"] || "排行";
var rankParam = rankMap[rankType];

// 榜单选择器（权重1，独占一行）
result.push({
    "title": "榜单",
    "type": "select",
    "chars": ["排行","收藏","字数","连载","人气","推荐","新书","热门"],
    "default": rankType,
    "action": "java.refreshExplore()",
    "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1}
});

// 当前榜单的“全部”入口（权重1）
result.push({
    "title": rankType,
    "url": "/noveltop_" + rankParam + "_{{page}}.html",
    "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1}
});

// 9个分类（权重0.25，4个一行）
var cats = ["玄幻","仙侠","都市","军事","网游","科幻","悬疑","女生","其他"];
for (var i = 0; i < cats.length; i++) {
    result.push({
        "title": cats[i],
        "url": "/noveltop_" + rankParam + "_" + (i + 1) + "_{{page}}.html",
        "style": {"layout_flexGrow": 1, "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25}
    });
}

JSON.stringify(result);
</js>
